quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: What color are the lines that separate traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. They are placed in the center of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed at any time. Regulation signs like this one show rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What do crossbuck signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs mark railroad crossings. Drivers must yield to trains and should not try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can turn left or go straight from that lane at an intersection. It is a regulation sign that shows what drivers may do.

questions.question: If a vehicle with high beams is coming toward you, where should you look?
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid being blinded by the oncoming headlights. This helps you stay on your course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: When can you drive across a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross them to change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: When turning left from a multilane, one-way street, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: When should you allow more space between your vehicle and the one in front?
questions.explanation: Allow extra space when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle in front rolls backward, you will have room to avoid a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you should stay on the right side of the road to avoid danger ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park your vehicle here.

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beams on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beams on.
questions.explanation: When you stop at night, turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beam headlights on. This helps other drivers see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: When may you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
questions.explanation: Always stop completely at a stop sign before entering an intersection. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before you enter the intersection. Then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm with an aggressive driver. Slow down and let them pass. Do not look at them or make rude gestures. Put as much distance between your vehicle and theirs as possible.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: When should you not pass another vehicle?

options.text: When school bus lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: Never pass on hills, curves, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on bridges, or in any no passing zone. Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights. Do not pass if you cannot see oncoming traffic clearly.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your reflexes and judgment?

options.text: Beer affects you less than wine.
Wine affects you less than beer.
Hard ciders and mixed drinks affect you the most.
It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: It depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: All types of alcohol harm your reflexes and judgment. The type of alcohol does not matter. Only the amount of alcohol in your bloodstream affects how impaired you are.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol help?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level or make you sober. Coffee may keep you awake, but it cannot change how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to yield. Slow down and let other traffic pass. You may go only when the road is clear and safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line in the center of the road mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go in the same direction.
You may pass even if it is unsafe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A single dashed yellow line separates traffic going in opposite directions. You can pass, but only if it is safe and you will not interfere with oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal tells you it is safe to do so.

questions.question: You are borrowing a vehicle you have never driven before. You should:

options.text: Just drive it because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where the controls are and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where the controls are and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to find the turn signals, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: Checking your blind spot by turning your head before changing lanes or merging is:

options.text: Not needed if you use your mirror.

questions.explanation: Always check your blind spots by looking over your shoulder before changing lanes. Do not rely only on mirrors.

questions.question: If your car has Anti-Lock Brakes and loses grip on a wet road, you should:

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: When your car loses grip, press hard on the brake and keep it pressed. Keep steering to safety. The Anti-Lock Brake System will pump the brakes for you. If you release the brake or pump it yourself, the system will not work.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road ahead has low clearance. Tall vehicles may not fit.

questions.question: Motorcycles are allowed to use:

options.text: The full width of a regular traffic lane.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The full width of a regular traffic lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the entire lane width, just like other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. Workers may be on or near the road. Slow down and be very careful.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Stop your vehicle at or near the accident.
Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.explanation: If you are in an accident, you must stop at or near the scene. Move your vehicle out of traffic if you can. Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes—another vehicle could hit you. Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.question: How do you pass a slower car on a two-lane road with traffic in both directions?

options.text: Do not cross the center line.
Flash your lights at oncoming cars.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road with traffic in both directions, you must use the oncoming traffic lane to pass safely. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a railroad crossing warning sign?

options.text: Speed up to cross before the train arrives.
Be ready to stop if a train is near.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.
Assume there are no trains and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is near.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs warn you that a train may be coming. Always obey these signs and never go around barriers or ignore the warning.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it:

options.text: Breaks down faster in your body.

questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your blood, it slows your reactions, makes you feel more confident, and causes you to make more driving mistakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill or steep downhill section ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A new lane has been added.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that drivers from both directions can use the center lane only to turn left. Do not use the center lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?
questions.explanation: Brown signs show areas of historical importance or public recreation. They help you find these places when traveling in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can park for a maximum of two hours during the times shown.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your judgment of speed and distance gets worse.
You calm down and can concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and can concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, makes it harder to see clearly, changes how you judge speed and distance, reduces your ability to recover from headlight glare, and often makes you take more risks.

questions.question: When exiting a highway, when should you slow down?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you have moved into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you have moved into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane well ahead of time. Do not slow down until after you have moved into the exit lane.

questions.question: If you experience a tire blowout, what should you do?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.

questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, release the gas pedal and do not brake immediately. Gradually slow down, then gently apply the brakes and pull safely off the road.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you will need to use extra force to steer. Reduce your speed and move to a safe area off the road to stop.

questions.question: Traffic is backing up behind you because you are driving slowly. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
Do not let the other cars pass your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the right side of the road and let traffic pass.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is dangerous. On a two-lane road, if traffic backs up behind you, you must pull over and let other vehicles pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when weather or road conditions require it.

questions.question: A driver who goes much slower than the speed limit may:

options.text: Should not let following cars pass.

questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic is dangerous. On a two-lane road, if traffic backs up behind you, you must pull over and let other vehicles pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when weather or road conditions require it.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with siren and/or flashing lights is approaching. What must you do immediately?

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on your four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle uses lights, sirens, or other warning devices, you must immediately move to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Stop and proceed when a green light appears.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: You see two solid yellow lines dividing the highway. You may cross them:

options.text: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
To pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing is allowed in either direction. You may cross them only to turn left into an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: How can you avoid making emergency stops in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other vehicles.
Drive in the right lane only.
Drive slower than the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other vehicles.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance lets you react to problems without emergency braking, which could cause a crash with the car behind you.
